preconditions.description: The two strings s1 and s2 have equal length.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1)
preconditions.description: Each character in s1 is either 'x' or 'y'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: Each character in s2 is either 'x' or 'y'.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if not possible else min(swaps_x_x + swaps_y_y, swaps_x_y + swaps_y_x)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of swaps required to make s1 and s2 equal, or -1 if it is impossible.
